title: Refraction Pool
description: A shallow pool of liquid crystal catches the starlight and splits it into dazzling arcs that dance across the surrounding rocks. The fluid is warm to the touch and faintly magnetic, drawing loose crystals toward its surface where they slowly dissolve into shimmering sediment.

choices.label: Harvest the crystallized edges
choices.description: The rim of the pool is crusted with hardened prism shards where the liquid evaporated.

outcomes.text: The crystal crust crumbles away in satisfying chunks. The shards ring softly as they clink together.
You find an especially thick deposit where the pool once overflowed. The shards here are larger and more vibrant.
The pool flares with sudden light as you disturb its edge. Refracted beams lance into your eyes like needles.

choices.label: Bathe in the refracted light
choices.description: The pool's prismatic radiance soothes aches and closes wounds with gentle warmth.

outcomes.text: The light washes over your party like warm rain. Aches fade, cuts close, and fatigue melts away.
The pool's light intensifies as you approach, bathing the party in brilliant restorative energy.
The light soothes most of you, but one hero catches a concentrated beam that leaves spots dancing in their vision.

choices.label: Move on
choices.description: The pool is beautiful, but there are more pressing matters ahead.

outcomes.text: You admire the dancing light for a moment, then press onward through the Expanse.
